general_rules.name: signature_formal
general_rules.description: Use full signature block with title and phone for external clients, suppliers, and C-suite
general_rules.trigger: External email or formal internal communication (CEO, finance, suppliers, prospects)
general_rules.action: End with 'Sophie Martin | Chef de projet - Division Digitale | TechCorp | +33 6 12 34 56 78'

general_rules.name: signature_casual
general_rules.description: Use first name only for direct team members in casual exchanges
general_rules.trigger: Internal email to direct reports or team members in casual tone

general_rules.name: language_switch_english
general_rules.description: Switch to English for international partners and non-French contacts
general_rules.trigger: Email to .com, .co.kr, .de domains or international companies
general_rules.action: Write entire email in English with appropriate English greetings

general_rules.name: structured_updates
general_rules.description: Use numbered lists and clear sections for status reports, planning, and updates
general_rules.trigger: Sprint planning, status updates, meeting recaps, multi-point emails
general_rules.action: Structure with numbered lists, clear sections (Completed/In progress/Blocker), and bullet points

general_rules.name: cc_relevant_people
general_rules.description: CC technical lead Pierre for architecture discussions and client technical questions
general_rules.trigger: External client questions about technical aspects or complex integrations
general_rules.action: Add Pierre Durand in CC with explicit mention in email body

general_rules.name: action_items_section
general_rules.description: End client emails and meeting recaps with explicit 'Actions à suivre' section
general_rules.trigger: Client demos, meeting recaps, project updates with follow-up tasks
general_rules.action: Add 'Actions à suivre:' section with clear bullet points

general_rules.name: vouvoiement_external
general_rules.description: Use formal 'vous' form with external clients, suppliers, prospects, and senior management
general_rules.trigger: Email to external contacts or C-suite (CEO, external clients, suppliers)

general_rules.name: tutoiement_team
general_rules.description: Use casual 'tu' form with direct team members (Pierre, Lucas, Camille)
general_rules.trigger: Internal email to direct reports and close colleagues

general_rules.name: professional_title_external
general_rules.description: Use professional titles (Madame, Monsieur) for initial contact with external formal contacts
general_rules.trigger: First or early emails to external clients, suppliers, or formal business contacts

general_rules.name: concise_acknowledgments
general_rules.trigger: Confirming receipt, simple agreements, quick status updates to team

general_rules.name: technical_precision
general_rules.description: Be specific and technical when discussing implementations with dev team
general_rules.trigger: Code reviews, technical discussions, architecture decisions with developers
general_rules.action: Use precise technical terms, mention file names, line numbers, specific technologies

general_rules.name: follow_up_questions
general_rules.description: End emails with clear next-step questions when coordination needed
general_rules.trigger: Planning discussions, proposal reviews, scheduling needs
general_rules.action: End with specific question like 'Cette date vous convient-elle ?' or 'Ton avis ?'

auto_reply_patterns: VPN/IT support tickets: brief confirmation when issue resolved ('Merci, ça fonctionne')
Simple absence acknowledgment: 'Pas de souci, c'est noté. Profite bien !'
Quick agreement on technical decisions: 'Parfait, on part là-dessus' or 'OK pour [decision]'
Sprint completion acknowledgment: 'Super ! Si tu finis tôt, [next task suggestion]'
